 By bronze, by gold, in oceangreen of shadow. Bloom. Old Bloom.

html_source: References to copulation here using musical imagery. A baton is a sticklike object that a conductor uses to lead his orchestra. Here a baton cool protruding is a highly phallic image which refers to the sexual excitement Bloom is feeling. He is most entranced by the two barmaids, imagining Lydia and Mina together. The oceangreen of shadow brings back to the reader’s mind the siren imagery. One rapped, one tapped, with a carra, with a cock refers to what Bloom is imagining doing with the barmaids, again utilizing musical lexicon to detail this desire.
